task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Solve MaxCut with QAOA (p=1) in Cirq for the graph [(0, 1), (0, 3), (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4)]: scan a grid of (gamma, beta) values, pick the best, sample the circuit and report the best cut.
